_provenance.status: APP-AUTHORED example records — no service owns them (see lib/api-client/burial-schedule.ts)
brief: Client minutes of meeting (Villa Memorial, 2026-09-21), item 2 — Calendar Integration for Light Pickup and Burial Schedule: 'Integrate a calendar into the system to record and manage burial schedules. The calendar shall include the pickup schedule of lights, corresponding to the date of burial.'

The staff Schedule surface (/staff/schedule) renders this recorded sheet as a month/week calendar: each burial carries its own light-pickup entry, tied to the burial's own date, so preparation and coordination staff see what is coming and where a pickup conflicts.
note: WHAT THIS IS: the office's recorded burial + light-pickup sheet, as the staff calendar shows it today. A burial's identity (deceased name, case, coordinator) comes from the recorded case; the lot comes from the property record. The APP-AUTHORED half is the schedule itself (date, time, and the light pickup's time/crew/state), which no platform service serves: scheduling-resources owns bookings, interments belong to property, and NO contract names a burial-schedule or light-pickup record.

WHAT IT CROSS-REFERENCES (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/burial-schedule.test.ts): every burial's case_number is a lib/fixtures/operations/cases.json case and its deceased_name/coordinator agree with that case; every lot_number/section is a lib/fixtures/property/lots.json row and agrees with the interment record in lib/fixtures/property/lot-lifecycle.json; the light-pickup crew is an office ROLE label, never a named person (no individual is invented).

NEVER INVENTED: no amount, price or fee appears anywhere; no identity is invented (deceased and coordinator are the case's own words). One demo conflict is present on 2026-09-30 — the Delivery crew is recorded for two light pickups at the same 3:00 PM — so the calendar's conflict flag can be seen; it is described here, not hidden.
DEMO DATA ONLY: fixture mode only. Live mode (SCHEDULING_BASE_URL set) answers 503 BURIAL_SCHEDULE_NOT_WIRED rather than dressing these rows up as service data.
CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the recorded demo records are REMOVED. The office's reference data is kept; a record is written only when the office actually records one.
